registrySources.assessment: The complete current ClinicalTrials.gov API record was read. NCT07101783 remains a completed Phase 1 pharmacokinetic study of NNC0662-0419 in Japanese, Chinese and non-Asian participants with overweight or obesity. olatorepatideEvidence.title: Hansoh: EASD 2026 LIGHTEN Phase III olatorepatide presentation
olatorepatideEvidence.checkScope: Complete original sponsor announcement read for the Chinese LIGHTEN Phase III design, participant count, completion, estimands, group-level weight changes and sponsor-reported gastrointestinal event rates; not automatically content-monitored.
olatorepatideEvidence.summary: Hansoh's 2 October sponsor announcement reports a 48-week randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled Chinese Phase III LIGHTEN study in 604 adults with overweight or obesity. It reports 90.1% completion and, under the efficacy estimand, mean body-weight changes of -12.5%, -17.5% and -19.3% for weekly olatorepatide 5 mg, 10 mg and 15 mg versus -2.7% for placebo. Under the treatment-regimen estimand it reports -11.8%, -17.0% and -18.7% versus -2.5%.
olatorepatideEvidence.limitations: These are sponsor-reported conference findings, not registry-posted results or a reviewed full paper. The sponsor reports average nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea and constipation rates across treatment groups and no treatment-related discontinuations or withdrawals; the Watch does not adopt the announcement's comparative tolerability framing. The Chinese study population and group averages are not personal predictions, a cross-trial ranking, UK authorisation, NICE or NHS access, UK supply, an approved dose or clinical approval.
